title: Envirotech Vehicles to move headquarters to Houston, manufacture electric vehicles locally
summary: Envirotech Vehicles to move headquarters to Houston, manufacture electric vehicles locally
body_markdown:
Envirotech Vehicles (Nasdaq: EVTV) has staked out its new headquarters in Houston and is already seeking additional manufacturing space in the area.


For more information:


- Visit:[Houston Business Journal](https://www.bizjournals.com/houston/news/2025/02/12/envirotech-vehicles-electric-relocation.html)
